skill.name: set-up-shopware-meta-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Set up Meta bidding for observed customer lifetime value from a Shopware 6 sales channel using Product Metrics. Check tracking readiness and guide a user through choosing a lifetime revenue or profit conversion in Meta.
skill.summary: Check Shopware tracking and set up lifetime value bidding in Meta.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown or ordinary setup checks, but the workflow calls external tools, reads order details, and can load unpinned remote instructions. The guide can expose an access token to the assistant and enable broader live Meta event delivery than the LTV setup request implies. It also points to an order profit event in one place instead of the lifetime profit event.

remediation.issue: Meta access token may pass through the assistant.
remediation.suggestion: Require token entry in the authenticated app or use a secret reference. Remove all instructions to request raw tokens in chat or pass them as command arguments.

remediation.issue: Meta destination setup can enable live sharing beyond LTV events.
remediation.suggestion: Keep live delivery off while testing. Before enabling it, confirm the merchant's pixel, event categories, customer fields, and consent settings.

remediation.issue: The main guide names the order profit event for an LTV goal.
remediation.suggestion: Use PMProfitLTV with CUSTOMER_PROFIT_LTV consistently. Keep PMOrderProfit in the separate order profit workflow.

remediation.issue: Tool use can reach account data or change settings without a dedicated approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the workspace, property, and sales channel before queries or writes. Limit order queries to test records and require approval for each state change.

remediation.issue: Remote guidance, installers, and browser destinations are not pinned or verified.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions and pin installers to immutable versions. Validate browser destinations against approved domains before sharing them with the merchant.

semantic_findings.title: Meta access token can enter assistant context
semantic_findings.description: The Meta guide says to enter the token in the app but also says an assistant must ask for it. The main guide directs the assistant to pass a supplied token to a command. That path can expose the token in chat or tool records even when it is not echoed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both instructions explicitly permit assistant handling of the raw token. Neither specifies a protected input mechanism for that route.

semantic_findings.title: Live Meta delivery can exceed the requested event scope
semantic_findings.description: The connection checklist says to leave sending enabled and makes the test code optional. The destination sends standard commerce events, other custom events, and consented matching data, not just LTV events. Delivery can start before the merchant selects the LTV conversion.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setup defaults and payload table show the broader scope. The documented consent gate limits delivery but does not replace the merchant's approval of that scope.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting event guidance can change the bidding objective
semantic_findings.description: The main guide points to PMOrderProfit and ORDER_PROFIT for profit bidding. The LTV reference specifies PMProfitLTV and CUSTOMER_PROFIT_LTV for lifetime profit. Following the main guide can make a live ad set optimize for order profit instead of lifetime profit.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The event names and purpose rules differ explicitly. The merchant makes the final selection, so the mismatch can affect bidding but does not change it automatically.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopware Lifetime Value Bidding in Meta
content.value_statement: A single purchase does not capture what a returning customer spends over time. Use Product Metrics to check Shopware tracking and guide the setup of a lifetime revenue or profit conversion in Meta.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP and identify incomplete steps.
Guide pairing one Shopware sales channel and verifying delivery to the intended Meta pixel.
Check whether a synced Shopware order is classified as new or returning.
Explain the consent and cost requirements for lifetime revenue and profit events.
Guide the merchant through creating and selecting an LTV custom conversion in Meta.
limitations: Requires a compatible Shopware 6.7 setup, Product Metrics Pro, and authorized access to the store and Meta pixel.
The merchant completes steps in Shopware and Meta, including choosing the ad set conversion event.
Lifetime value is observed within the paired sales channel. Orders from before the connection are not imported.
Profit LTV is not sent when the order has missing costs. Its running total also requires known costs for earlier orders.

use_cases.title: Check readiness for lifetime revenue bidding
use_cases.description: Find out whether the paired sales channel and Meta destination are ready before setting up a revenue LTV conversion.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a missing profit LTV event
use_cases.description: Check whether a missing event is due to consent, incomplete costs, or a test order that Meta has not received.

use_cases.title: Prepare a value-based campaign test
use_cases.description: Verify the correct event and purpose rule before manually selecting a lifetime value conversion in one ad set.

prompt_templates.title: Check the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to set up lifetime revenue bidding for my Shopware store in Meta? Give me a checklist without accessing my accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Review connection status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my confirmed Shopware sales channel and Product Metrics property. Tell me which steps remain. Do not change settings or request credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot missing profit events
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: verifying a paid test order
prompt_templates.prompt: Meta received revenue LTV but not profit LTV for my paid test order. Check the consent, costs, and delivery status without showing customer data.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-campaign test
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue LTV and profit LTV for one Meta campaign. Verify the event and purpose rule, then outline the test and manual ad set changes. Do not publish changes.

output_examples.input: Is my connected Shopware channel ready for revenue LTV bidding?
output_examples.output: The Shopware channel is active, but Meta has not received a revenue LTV event. Verify delivery with a paid test order before creating the custom conversion.

output_examples.input: Why did my test order send a revenue LTV event but no profit LTV event?
output_examples.output: The test order has an unknown product cost. Complete the cost settings and validate with a new test order.

output_examples.input: What should I choose in Meta for lifetime profit bidding?
output_examples.output: Choose the lifetime profit event, not the order profit event. Confirm the customer profit LTV purpose rule before selecting the custom conversion in your ad set.

best_practices: Verify the storefront, sales channel, and Meta pixel before enabling live delivery.
Enter access tokens only in the authenticated app and keep them out of chat.
Confirm consent and event delivery with a paid test order before changing an ad set.
anti_patterns: Do not use the order profit event for a lifetime profit objective.
Do not bypass the consent banner or enable live sending before reviewing what data leaves the store.
Do not copy the ordinary purchase ROAS target to an LTV conversion without reviewing the difference in event values.

faq.question: Which Shopware versions are supported?
faq.answer: The documented plugin targets Shopware 6.7.14.0 and requires PHP 8.2 or later. Shopware 5 is not supported.

faq.question: Does this predict future customer lifetime value?
faq.answer: No. It uses observed paid orders in the paired sales channel. Orders from before setup are not imported.

faq.question: What does Meta receive on a qualifying order?
faq.answer: The LTV event uses what the order adds and includes the running total when available. With consent, matching data can also accompany the event.

faq.question: Why does the LTV event not appear in Events Manager?
faq.answer: Meta must receive the event first. Use a paid test order with the required consent and complete costs if you are testing profit.

faq.question: Can the assistant select the ad set conversion for me?
faq.answer: No. The skill guides you through the steps, but you create the custom conversion and select it in Meta.

faq.question: Is profit LTV the same as order profit bidding?
faq.answer: No. Profit LTV uses the lifetime profit event. Order profit bidding uses a separate conversion event.
